user.title: Set up BRigt
user.description: This integration talks to the BRigt add-on running on this Home Assistant host. It adds the party_mode, start_show and stop_show services and a show-status sensor.

confirm.title: BRigt discovered
confirm.description: Confirm setup to enable the light-show services and status sensor.

party_mode.name: Start party mode
party_mode.description: Play the configured (or given) music folder on a media player and run each track's compiled light show in sync.

media_player.name: Media player
media_player.description: Which media player plays the music. Defaults to the last one calibrated.

folder.name: Music folder
folder.description: Folder under /media to play. Defaults to the add-on's music_folder option.

vibe.name: Vibe
vibe.description: Optional steer for the director, e.g. "chill", "rave", "halloween".

start_show.name: Start a show
start_show.description: Play one track and its compiled light show.

media_player.name: Media player
media_player.description: Which media player plays the music. Defaults to the last one calibrated.

stop_show.name: Stop the show
stop_show.description: Stop playback and restore every light to its pre-show state.
